libgme (Game Music Emu) 0.6.5, https://github.com/libgme/game-music-emu tag 0.6.5, upstream commit 9e23d10f9fd2a6a2f33b10912dd8dc7153258995 (fetched 2026-10-26 from the tag tarball). License: GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1 or later, text in LICENSE (upstream license.txt); Ym2612_GENS.cpp is LGPL 2.1+ as well (the MAME YM2612 core, which is GPL, is not vendored).
Copied unchanged: every gme/*.cpp and gme/*.h of the tag except the VGM/VGZ emulator (Vgm_*, Ym2413_*, emu2413 under ext/), the MAME and Nuked YM2612 variants, and the CMake-generated gme_types.h. gme_types.h here is Selecta's own (no VGM). zlib is not used (HAVE_ZLIB_H undefined), so compressed .vgz and gzipped inputs are not read. VGM is claimed by the libvgm replayer (I431), not here.
Linking: static, LGPL 2.1 section 6 applies; the vendored sources stay replaceable in this directory.
Named VERSION.txt, not VERSION: the directory is an include path and on a case-insensitive file system a file called VERSION shadows the C++ standard header <version>.
Also copied unchanged: ext/emu2413.c and ext/emu2413.h from the same tag (YM2413 core for the NES VRC7 chip, Nes_Vrc7_Apu.cpp), license in ext/LICENSE.emu2413.
